entries.title: Fix mobile Activity thread navigation
entries.rationale: Reject the upstream commit as a complete intake unit because its changed surface includes visible bee refresh/loading branding that conflicts with the Zion branding guard. Preserve the thread-navigation behavior only as a separately reviewed future adaptation after replacing all visible upstream branding with Zion treatment.
verification: Full-SHA mobile navigation diff, changed bee-branded widgets/assets, tests, visible-branding guard implications, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
